claims.statement: For PSD 3x3 packet Grams G1+G2+G3=I with lambda1(Gk)>=alpha, either rainbow mixed volume T is at least (2/9) alpha beta^2 or some pair sum has lambda2<beta; the latter forces total transverse packet mass <2 beta and complementary transverse Gram >(1-beta)I.

With alpha=453/4096 and beta=1/64, either T>=151/25165824 or two physical packets have total squared leakage from one spectral line <1/32 while the complementary packet carries >63/64 in both transverse directions.

On the large-rainbow side with a physical row of leverage >1/2, either conditioning away that original coordinate leaves a rank-three block with s_min and determinant magnitude >=151/50331648, or conditioning the rest of its packet leaves singleton hub plus two original-coordinate banks with the same lower scale and fixed-hub rainbow packet >151/50331648.
If the normalized active child from the delete/isolate theorem has all physical leverages <=1/2, the completed Fresnel--Brascamp--Lieb theorem gives a continuous density with norm <833.
In the exact longitudinal/transverse partition scope of account04/B20, |e^TMe|<=1/2 gives continuous density <105.463; the complementary |e^TMe|>1/2 gives a physical scalar pivot >1/4.
